propositions: Git probe calls in repo-isolation guard (porcelain and head) have no subprocess timeout and can block pytest indefinitely after test completion
Subprocess module monkeypatching by test code contaminates autouse fixture teardown because the guard dereferences the shared subprocess module at post-fixture time
Timeout must be raised as explicit subprocess.TimeoutExpired and not collapsed to None so hung probes fail loudly rather than silently
Test doubles of time.sleep inside subprocess internals can trigger during Popen._wait backoff when the guard runs under CI load, requiring stable namespace isolation
Fixed 5-second watchdog with bound real process runner and stable sleep namespace prevents both hung Git processes and test-double contamination while preserving None for ordinary probe failures
